description: Explicit allowlist for backend routes that can return files, download links, exports, or printable data packages.

routes.reason: Returns an OSS download link and requires the dedicated netdisk:manage:download permission.
Returns a protected upload preview by opaque token only after scanStatus=2; token URLs are unguessable, expiring, and served with no-store headers.
Returns a protected uploaded file by id and requires tool:storage:read plus tenantId and areaId authorization; responses use no-store headers.
Refreshes a short-lived protected upload preview link and requires tool:storage:sign plus tenantId and areaId authorization.
Records an audited medical-record print event before browser printing; returns no medical payload and validates tenantId, areaId, and current-staff scope through VisitService.
